verdict.rationale: Wise's multi-currency account (MCA) is explicitly documented to let users hold, convert, and fund transfers with balances in up to 56 currencies, plus receiving payments via global account details in 40+ currencies, all under one account. Community evidence corroborates real-world use (account details, reliability) though also notes some friction with account detail changes, which is a secondary operational caveat rather than a contradiction of the core multi-currency holding capability. Missing for 10: independent quantitative benchmarking or a hands-on demo of holding/converting many currencies simultaneously.
